### Signs in the Heavens
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/signs-in-the-heavens
Passage: Revelation 6:12-17
Points:
- The opening of the sixth seal depicts dramatic, universe-transforming judgment as creation seems to come undone.
- Like similar imagery in Old Testament prophecy, this language communicates momentous redemptive shifts rather than strictly literal cosmic collapse.
- Regardless of interpretative dating, the scene underscores that God will unfailingly judge everyone who opposes Him.
- Worldly power, prestige, and wealth provide no hiding place or protection on the day of judgment.
- True and lasting security belongs solely to those who place their trust in God alone.

### Who Can Prevail Against God’s Wrath?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-july-15-2023.html
Passage: Revelation 6:17
Points:
- Revelation 6:17 announces the arrival of divine wrath, presenting a terrifying reckoning that no unbeliever can withstand.
- Scripture illustrates that God preserves His people from His ultimate wrath, mirroring the deliverances of Noah and Lot.
- Believers may experience earthly tribulations, but Christ ensures His followers are delivered from the final outpouring of wrath.
- Contemplating the coming day of wrath should awaken an urgent desire to walk faithfully and share the gospel with others.
